Name: Mizu's Turkey
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
[b][color=#cc0000]Updating to the latest version? Please see the stickied comment![/color][/b]

Do you like the birds which go gobble gobble? Maybe you really need some roast turkey or finally want to cook a turducken in your game? This mod is for you! It adds turkey as a new [b]coop [/b]animal. 

[list]
[*]Turkeys lay [b]Turkey Eggs[/b] every three days.[/*]
[*]Turkeys drop [b]Turkey Feathers[/b] at high friendship.[/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the [b]Special Order: Talk Turkey to Me.[/b] [/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 4 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ turkey meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead or become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] installed to change the text of the recipe book when learning. It's entirely aesthetic.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Brown and White appearances are enabled. You can toggle on one more below.

[b]Enable Gray Turkey[/b] (false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Gray Turkey texture and adds it to the possible turkey appearances.

[center][img]https://imgur.com/Z3PY4Wr.png[/img][/center]
[b]Q: Why are all my turkeys are error chickens?
A: [/b]This mod now requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url], allowing the turkey to natively live in the coop. [b]Please ensure you have that installed first of all. [/b]If they stay error chickens, you can sell them safely and rebuy new animals from Marnie.

[b]Q: Why can't I add more turkeys to the barn?
A: [/b] Turkey now natively live in the coop. If some of your turkeys currently live in the barn, you can use various methods (moving mods / sell & rebuy) to move them to a coop.

[b]Q: Why did my birds change colors?
A: [/b] There were some updates to treat all the animals as a singular species. Animals should migrate to the new format, but if the skins are different than what you expected your animals to be, you can change them with the Scissors tool in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!

[center][img]https://imgur.com/5exTlaQ.png[/img][/center]
